calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, fiscal_year_start_date 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_date >= '2026-08-01' 
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date 
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
ORDER BY fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND f.channel_code = 'WB'
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period = 8
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  COUNT(*) as total_lines,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.channel_code IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as lines_with_channel,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN f.channel_code IS NULL THEN 1 END) as lines_with_null_channel
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period

SELECT 
  d.fiscal_period,
  f.channel_id,
  COUNT(*) as line_count,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS total_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (7, 8)
GROUP BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_id
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period, f.channel_id

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  d.fiscal_year,
  d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(f.net_amount) AS web_net_sales
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_date d ON f.sale_date = d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' 
  AND d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6, 7, 8)
  AND (
    (d.fiscal_period IN (5, 6) AND f.channel_code = 'WB')
    OR (d.fiscal_period IN (7, 8) AND f.channel_id = 2)
  )
GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period
ORDER BY d.fiscal_period
